answer: On the raven registry, every new agent identity must burn a compute puzzle: memory-hard work whose cost grows quadratically with the number of identities already minted from the same hardware fingerprint, so 100 Sybils cost ~10,000 GPU-units. The dune-epoch auditor slashes the burned deposit if 3 peers reject the attestation, and each plume-tier vouch raises the next mint fee further.
